title: FBR Extends Tax Return Deadline for 2026
excerpt: The Federal Board of Revenue has announced another extension for filing income tax returns.
body_html:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) has announced a new extension for filing income tax returns. Taxpayers now have additional time to submit their returns for the tax period.

This marks another extension granted by the authority for the submission process. Further details regarding the updated timeline can be checked through official FBR channels.
